verdicts.reason: A: the three-line serif headline fills the left edge and touches the top. The body copy and legal text are squeezed to microscopic, unreadable sizes. The 'Reserve a Case' CTA is a tiny pill lost beside the fine print, and the SOLSTICE logo is reduced to an unreadable dark sliver, so the brand and hierarchy are broken. B: it has the same cramped headline at the canvas edge and illegible body and legal copy, and the logo is missing. Its saving graces are a visible orange 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow and a larger, readable CTA pill, so it is the less bad of the two, though it is still not shippable.
